meta.title: Inbox
meta.description: A Telegram bot for DSH: messages land in the history, the agent can read them and reply in your name, and the plugin page keeps the bot token, the chat whitelist, the current session and a command cheat sheet. An allow-listed chat can control DSH with /sessions, /use N, /ask, /steer, /new and /cancel — nobody is allowed by default until a chat is added. The bot token is kept in the DSH credential store under TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and never reaches the browser. Find it under Plugins.
